note: Visible tests cover priority order, first-in-first-out for two equal items, peek, len, an empty pop, one cancel and a reprioritize that moves an item ahead of a lower one; only the hidden tests cover ticket numbering, cancel and reprioritize of tickets that are not waiting, the place a reprioritized item takes among equals, and items that cannot be compared or hashed.

twin_breaks.rule: The item keeps its place in push order: among items of its new priority it comes out before those pushed after it and after those pushed before it.
